_howto: Delivery portfolio, grouped by programme rather than repository. Derived from the ESLABS101 / workelate GitHub account on 2026-07-22 (300 accessible repositories, 2019-2026). `repos` is the count of repositories in that programme and is evidence, not a marketing number. `named: false` means the client has not confirmed we may use their name, so the site renders the descriptor only. Run `node scripts/gencorpus.mjs` after editing.

projects.name: RockProsUSA
projects.headline: A dispatch platform across four apps and 13 quarry sites
projects.what: Aggregates producer running 13 sites on one system. We built the whole surface: a customer ordering app, a trucker app, a driver app, an admin console and the dispatch backend behind them, plus native React Native builds for the field.
outcomes: dispatch cycle time down 38%
2,140 invoices with zero manual touches
11,200 operations hours returned in year one

projects.name: WorkElate
projects.sector: Our own product, AI-native operating system
projects.headline: A full office suite we build on and sell from
projects.what: Mail, calendar, tasks, forms, boards, docs, data, presentations, a hub, an auth service, an admin console and a public SDK. Our own agency delivery runs on it, which is why we can say what agent systems do at commercial stakes rather than in a demo.
outcomes: 28 repositories in active development
the agency's own delivery runs on it

projects.name: CitiSense
projects.headline: AI marketing and sales platform for agencies
projects.what: Campaign operations, sales workflow and reporting carried by agents, including AI-native planning for outdoor and indoor billboards, digital and physical, so that agency teams spend their hours on creative work instead of coordination.
outcomes: live with agencies and display teams in Mexico

projects.name: the Deployer platform
projects.headline: A product family: apps, admin, billing and journey mapping
projects.what: A suite of deployable business apps with a shared React component library, an admin console, subscription billing on Stripe and PayPal, a customer journey mapping module, a blog engine and a programmatic SEO service generating landing pages from templates.
outcomes: 25 repositories across the programme
two payment rails live

projects.name: Edunomics
projects.headline: A scholarship marketplace and the platform under it
projects.what: Donors publish scholarships, invite and review applicants and award grants; applicants build profiles, apply and track status. Around it: an accounts service, an admin console, a Next.js web front end and the backend carrying all of them. 33 API endpoints on the marketplace alone.
outcomes: 22 repositories over five years
donor, applicant and admin surfaces live

projects.name: an AI annotation platform
projects.headline: Human-plus-model labelling, five years before the hype
projects.what: A labelling platform for machine-learning datasets: polygon and bounding-box tooling on canvas, with a detection model running in the browser to pre-annotate every image before a human touched it. Exports to Pascal-VOC XML and JSON. Four engineers, 117 commits, one quarter.
outcomes: model-assisted pre-labelling shipped in 2020

projects.name: field and trade operations builds
projects.headline: Storefronts, admin consoles and field apps for owner-run businesses
projects.what: A recurring shape of work: a customer-facing front end, an admin console for the owner and a mobile app for the people in the field, delivered as one programme rather than three vendors.
outcomes: delivered across retail, comfort furnishing and marketplace clients

projects.name: risk, analytics and data builds
projects.headline: The plumbing that decides whether a dashboard can be trusted
projects.what: Risk scoring apps, analytics front ends, financial ETL pipelines and reconciliation jobs. Unglamorous work that determines whether every number above it is defensible.
outcomes: ingestion, normalisation and reconciliation running in production

projects.headline: Poems written from a person's life, for the Mexican altar tradition
projects.what: A creative product that turns the details of a person's life into a written poem, made for the Mexican Altar and Day of the Dead tradition of remembering someone by name.

projects.name: Data enrichment for a venture firm
projects.sourced: founder-asserted 2026-09-07, not yet matched to a repository
projects.headline: Company and deal data enriched for a VC firm's pipeline
projects.what: Enrichment of company and deal records for a venture capital firm, so that the investment team works from complete data instead of chasing it.

projects.name: Re-commerce marketplace
projects.headline: Photograph an item on your phone, list it straight to eBay
projects.what: A re-commerce operation: photograph an item, get it catalogued and priced, then listed to eBay through an authenticated integration service. Native iOS and Android, with payments, reporting and profile flows.
outcomes: 121 Swift files in the iOS app
a dedicated eBay OAuth integration service

projects.name: Quality management system
projects.headline: Quality management with its own scheduling and notification services
projects.what: A quality management system for manufacturing, built with separate cron and notification services beside the main API so that checks fire on schedule rather than when somebody remembers.
outcomes: separate cron and notification services
shares an in-house API framework reused across three programmes

projects.name: Innovation management platform
projects.headline: Staff pitch ideas against company challenges; the good ones reach an execution board
projects.what: An innovation platform: employees submit ideas against published challenges, ideas move through review stages with permissions and benefit scoring, and the survivors land on an execution board. Sold to several organisations, each on its own subdomain.
outcomes: tenant-per-subdomain, so it ran for several organisations at once

projects.name: Risk and controls platform
projects.headline: A risk register that proves whether the controls actually work
projects.what: A governance, risk and controls platform: risk matrix, controls and their effectiveness, objectives, KPIs, business units and remediation actions, with subscription billing on top.
outcomes: a commercial product, billed by subscription

projects.name: Field-sales CRM, native
projects.headline: A CRM built native for salespeople who live on their phones
projects.what: Field-sales CRM for property developers, built native on both platforms: opportunities by site, call dispositions, callbacks, task lists and push notifications. A separate Flutter CRM was built for another client.
outcomes: built in Swift, Kotlin, Java and Flutter across the engagements

projects.name: Service and maintenance management
projects.headline: Maintenance and site supervision, tracked instead of remembered
projects.what: A service management system covering maintenance work and site supervision, so that jobs, visits and follow-ups are tracked rather than carried in somebody's head.

projects.name: ERP connector, built many times over
projects.headline: The bridge that keeps Tally and the rest of the business in step
projects.what: An ERP connector between Tally and the systems around it, running on a schedule. Thirteen repositories over two years: most integrations with Tally are written once and abandoned, and this one was not.
outcomes: 13 repositories across the programme, which is repeat demand rather than one build

projects.name: Equipment rental marketplace
projects.headline: Owners list machinery, renters book it
projects.what: A two-sided marketplace for equipment rental: owners list machinery, renters find and book it, with the console over the top. One of the oldest programmes in the portfolio and still standing.
outcomes: shipped 2018 and iterated through 2023

projects.name: Plant production and BOM
projects.headline: Production reporting and bills of material, captured on the shop floor
projects.what: Production reporting and bill-of-material management for a plant, with shop-floor capture on mobile so the numbers come from where the work happens.
outcomes: the largest backend in the portfolio by file count

projects.name: Contract clause extraction
projects.headline: Upload a contract, get its clauses back as structured fields
projects.what: Document AI for contracts: a PDF goes in, structured clause data comes out. Built in 2021, before this became a product category.
outcomes: shipped in 2021
